purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claims) software system. It generates a daily statistics CSV file ('nikkei_' + date + '.csv') containing patient visit and insurance billing data for a given treatment date. It reads from an indexed receipt/payment file (BD00801), processes insurance combination records, and outputs structured CSV data with patient and insurance point/amount summaries.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese multi-byte characters (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) in comments and string literals, causing mojibake in the excerpt. This does not affect the COBOL structure assessment. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by JMA (Japan Medical Association). The COPY statements reference many project-specific copybooks not shown here. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/billing program — amounts use plain PIC S9(08).
